pr_title: docs(service-worker): improve docs related to `SwUpdate` APIs
pr_body:
This commit improves documentation related to recently improved or deprecated `SwUpdate` APIs in the following ways:

- Update [check-for-update.service.ts][1] to make use of the return value of [SwUpdate#checkForUpdate()][2].
- Update [prompt-update.service.ts][3] to not call [SwUpdate#activateUpdate()][4] and just reload the page.
- Update the [SwUpdate#activateUpdate()][4] API docs to explain that it is only useful if you want to update a client without reloading and that it can easily lead to version skew.
- Update [a code-snippet][5] to no longer be [hard-coded][6].

[1]: https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/9d9d05911dbd6e2f30e4c7bced0e41fd20ec4285/aio/content/examples/service-worker-getting-started/src/app/check-for-update.service.ts#L16
[2]: https://angular.io/api/service-worker/SwUpdate#checkForUpdate
[3]: https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/9d9d05911dbd6e2f30e4c7bced0e41fd20ec4285/aio/content/examples/service-worker-getting-started/src/app/prompt-update.service.ts#L15
[4]: https://angular.io/api/service-worker/SwUpdate#activateUpdate
[5]: https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/96c6139c9ab35aa6ab2330a5a79a5906d5c2e8be/packages/service-worker/src/update.ts#L44-L54
[6]: https://angular.io/guide/docs-style-guide#hard-coded-snippets

Fixes #43665.

issue_context.title: docs(service-worker): update docs to take the deprecations in #43535 into account
issue_context.body:
### Description

Once #43535 has been merged, we should update the [Available and activated updates][1] section of the [Service worker communication][2] guide (and the associated [example][3]) to not use the deprecated APIs.

As part of this work, we should also update [this code-snippet][4] to not be hard-coded.

##
Finally, while we're at it, we could also update the [prompt-update.service.ts][5], which shows reloading the page right after calling `SwUpdate#activateUpdate()`. This is a bad example, because just reloading the page should be enough to get a new client ID and get assigned to the latest SW version. (We should clarify that `SwUpdate#activateUpdate()` is only useful if you want to update a client without reloading and that it can easily lead to version skew, so should only be used if you know what you're doing and know it to be safe for your app.)

[1]: https://angular.io/guide/service-worker-communications#available-and-activated-updates
[2]: https://angular.io/guide/service-worker-communications
[3]: https://github.com/angular/angular/tree/9d9d05911dbd6e2f30e4c7bced0e41fd20ec4285/aio/content/examples/service-worker-getting-started/src/app
[4]: https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/0e9974969dc9dee964dcfeb6f8676b0e4ad20d73/packages/service-worker/src/update.ts#L44-L54
[5]: https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/9d9d05911dbd6e2f30e4c7bced0e41fd20ec4285/aio/content/examples/service-worker-getting-started/src/app/prompt-update.service.ts#L15

### What is the affected URL?

https://angular.io/guide/service-worker-communications#available-and-activated-updates
